content:
Parallelism gives
\[
\frac{2}{1}=\frac{n}{-2}\implies n=-4.
\]
Then
\[
l_2: 2x-4y-6=0 \implies x-2y-3=0.
\]
Distance between \(x-2y+m=0\) and \(x-2y-3=0\) is
\[
\frac{|m+3|}{\sqrt{1^2+(-2)^2}}=\frac{|m+3|}{\sqrt5}=2\sqrt5.
\]
So
\[
|m+3|=10.
\]
Since \(m>0\),
\[
m+3=10 \implies m=7.
\]
Thus
\[
m+n=7+(-4)=3.
\]
\[
\boxed{3}
\]
